Best in Ninh Bình
Oct 2019 • Friends
Coffee Phong has this amazing home coming feeling the moment you walk through the doors. The staff all great you with a warm smile and open arm's. The menu is simply great with a variety of western and Vietnamese foods. The food ordered tastes like a little peace of heaven and when hungry you don't wait long for your food. The owner Hóa offers bike rentals, bus booking and sleeper bus tickets. One of the few places in Vietnam where the people serve you in English. I would definitely recommend popping in when in Ninh Binh
